description: Reads the Live app's business numbers: people (total, active in 30 days, suspended), subscribers by plan, refund-aware revenue per currency. subscribers.byPlan[].count is everyone on the plan; byPlan[].paying is the ones who pay — never a comped subscriber, one in a free trial, or a Stripe subscription not being charged (unpaid, paused, incomplete); byPlan[].comped is how many are comped (the founder's own grant). MRR is each plan's monthly price × paying, never × count — say it the way the dashboard does, e.g. "3 subscribers · 2 paying, 1 comped". live:read; audited; changes nothing. This is what a founder may call how much they have made, or sales.
name: live_revenue
title: Live: business numbers
